target.description: Adversarial audit of P-R8B-01 protocol fidelity, frozen harness, result validity and WMR-H V0.2 architecture-decision readiness.

known_exposures: Claude participated in MC-0026 representation design and comparative critique.
Claude did not author the P-R8B-01 harness or ChatGPT's Research 265 result interpretation.
The audit is adversarial result interpretation, not an independent architecture-design claim.
independence.notes: Claude is independent of the concrete harness implementation/result write-up but not blind to the architecture candidate. This is sufficient for a bounded protocol/result audit, not a blind replication.

last_transition.reason: P-R8B-01 passed all 18 preregistered gates. Because the architecture decision is material and the harness/result interpretation were ChatGPT-authored, one bounded Claude result audit is required before the owner decision.
